<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex19062023-07-2412-59" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
            <milestone unit="section" n="[Colophon (16a5–16a7)"/>
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bdag</rs> gis brjed byang 'di bris pas || 
         mtha' yas sems can ma lus kun || 
         lta bas rmongs par ma gyur cing || 
         <lb n="16a6"/> spyod pa shin tu dag 'gyur te || 
         gol ba'i lam du mi 'gyur zhing || 
         'og myin gnas su 'gro bar shog || || 
         || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bdag</rs> kyang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma</rs>'i bka' drin gyis || 
         sa rab dga' ba thob bar du || 
         stong dang snying rje brtan pa dang ||
         <lb n="16a7"/> bdag dang gzhan du brje bar shog || || 
         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4605">bden chung gi 'bum</rs> | rdzogs s+ho | | | | rdzogs s+ho | |</seg></TEI>
